title: Reuse a chain number
result: This reuses the same chain, so its contents stay shared.

title: Clone a chain
result: The chain number changes; its phrase numbers remain shared.

control: Hold SELECT; press EDIT twice, with a selection
title: Clone a chain and its phrases
result: New chain and phrase numbers; instruments remain shared.

title: Open Phrase, then return to Song
result: Open Phrase, then return to Song

title: Clone selected phrases
result: A new phrase number holds the copied notes; instruments stay shared.

title: Open the selection bounce dialog
result: Bounce settings appear for the selected chain rows.

title: Raise a note by one step
result: Raise a note by one step

control: OPT + EDIT on an empty note
title: Insert a note-off

control: EDIT + UP / DOWN on an FX name
title: Choose an effect command
Open Instrument, then return to Chain
result: Open Instrument, then return to Chain

control: SELECT + EDIT, with only instrument cells selected
title: Clone the selected instruments
result: Selected instrument references change to new slots, with their default tables.

title: Paste an instrument into another slot
result: The instrument and its default table are copied into the chosen slot.

title: Open Table and return to Phrase
result: Open Table and return to Phrase

control: EDIT on the sample’s EDIT field
title: Open the sample editor
Move the playback start marker
result: The playback region start advances across the waveform.

title: Silence the processing selection
result: The selected audio becomes silent in memory.

title: Undo sample processing
result: The waveform returns to its previous state.

control: EDIT + UP / DOWN on an FX name
title: Choose a table effect

control: EDIT on a source or destination
title: Choose a modulation source
Open Instrument and track Insert FX
result: Open Instrument and track Insert FX

title: Paste into an empty instrument slot
result: The selected empty slot receives the copied instrument and table.

control: OPT + LEFT / RIGHT, in track Insert FX
title: View the next track’s inserts
Fill a rhythm pattern
result: The selected note cells receive successive fixed rhythm patterns.

title: Generate a random rhythm
result: Each press replaces the selected notes with another random rhythm.

title: Mutate an existing melody
result: Existing note pitches change; the pattern keeps its occupied steps.

title: Arpeggiate the selected notes
result: The existing notes are redistributed as a chord pattern.

control: OPT + UP, with only volumes selected
title: Randomise step volumes
result: Only the selected volume column changes.

control: EDIT + UP / DOWN, with full-width selection
title: Rotate phrase rows
result: The full-width selected rows rotate within the selected span.

title: Choose when a table restarts
result: Retrig cycles through Phrase, Chain and Free.

title: Copy phrase FX into a table
result: The copied ARP command and value appear in Table FX1.

title: Reorder instruments
result: The selected instrument moves down in the pool.

title: Switch between Standard and LFO views
result: The same wave is drawn as linear modulation steps around the centre line.

title: Copy a wave to another slot
result: The new wavetable slot contains the copied shape.

title: Divide a sample into equal slices
result: Equal slice boundaries appear on the waveform.

title: Change the number of slices
result: The sample is divided again using the selected count.

title: Browse individual slices
result: The highlighted slice region follows the slice browser.

title: Choose Clouds or Beads reverb
result: The algorithm changes and the page shows its corresponding controls.

title: Choose a drum model
result: Bogie changes model and exposes its active drum macros.

title: Choose an MME model
result: MME changes the interaction between its two oscillators.

title: Choose a digital percussion model
result: The digital drum model changes with its model-specific controls.

title: Edit an FM algorithm
result: The native FM algorithm changes in the operator editor.

title: Explore SID voice controls
result: The cursor moves through the native SID voice settings.

title: Override SoundFont tuning
result: An explicit tuning override replaces the Bank value.

title: Toggle the Song waveform
result: The display preference changes; capture defaults remain waveform-off.

title: Map a MIDI channel to an instrument
result: The channel mapping changes from Off to an instrument slot.

title: Transpose Beads grains
result: Pitch moves above its neutral value of 80; the hint shows the transposition.
